production.note: US model years 2017 to 2020. Stuttcars titles the car "Porsche Panamera Turbo (2017 – 2020)". Kelley Blue Book lists a 2020 Panamera Turbo and Turbo Sport Turismo (kbb-2020-panamera), and for 2021: "Panamera Turbo S models, which replace the Panamera Turbo, are powered by a significantly revamped twin-turbo 4.0-liter V8" (kbb-2021-panamera).

body.note: KBB lists the Turbo as "Sedan 4D" (a four-door liftback) and the Turbo Sport Turismo ("the more angular and slightly more practical wagon-like rear end of the Sport Turismo"), which arrived after launch. A long-wheelbase Executive was also sold; it is the same body style.

displacementL.note: 3,996 cc. Car and Driver's panel: "Displacement: 244 in3, 3996 cm3". Ultimate Specs agrees: "Engine displacement : 243.9 cu-in / 3996 cm3" (ultimatespecs-2017-panamera-turbo, a database).

fuel.note: Gasoline V8; inferred from the listing's description.

drivetrain.note: Stuttcars: all-wheel drive via Porsche Traction Management (PTM).

transmission.note: Porsche Finder: "8-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK), with manual actuation and automatic mode". Cars.com: "8-Speed A/T". DCT is Porsche PDK; no manual was offered.

powerHp.note: Car and Driver road-test panel '2017 Porsche Panamera Turbo' (owner copy), quote: "Power: 550 hp @ 6000 rpm". Agreeing: Porsche Finder listing of a 2017 Panamera Turbo, "Maximum power combustion engine 550 hp" and "550 hp @ 5750 - 6000 rpm" (porsche-finder-2017-panamera-turbo); Kelley Blue Book "550 @ 5750 RPM" (kbb-2017-panamera-turbo) and Cars.com "550 hp" (carscom-2017-panamera-turbo), both databases. Porsche's European launch release, reproduced by Stuttcars, gives "404 kW / 550 hp (at 5,750 rpm)" (a PS figure; stuttcars-panamera-turbo-971). No Porsche Cars North America spec sheet or release was opened.

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md); a measured weight of C/D's test car. Quote (C/D panel '2017 Porsche Panamera Turbo'): "Curb weight: 4593 lb". Test car: "front-engine, all-wheel-drive, 4-passenger, 4-door hatchback" (the standard-wheelbase car, not the Sport Turismo), "8-speed dual-clutch automatic with manual shifting mode" (the only transmission), "$162,680 (base price: $151,050)" as tested, so about $11,600 of options. The earlier provisional figure, 4,398 lb (Porsche Finder listing; KBB and Cars.com, databases), is 4.2% lower; see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's figure is the measured weight of an optioned test car ($11,630 of options); 4,398 lb is the listing/database curb weight for the base 2017 Panamera Turbo, probably Porsche's DIN-based figure. They differ by 4.2%.
discrepancies.resolution: Owner decision, 9 October 2026: the Car and Driver road-test curb weight is used (docs/DATA_GUIDE.md, Weight step 2). 4,593 lb used; the earlier 4,398 lb was the provisional figure.
